SELECT MIN(kt.kind) AS movie_kind,
       MIN(t.title) AS complete_us_internet_movie
FROM (
    SELECT id, kind_id, title
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year > 1990
) AS t
JOIN (
    SELECT id, kind
    FROM kind_type
    WHERE kind IN ('movie', 'tv movie', 'video movie', 'video game')
) AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
JOIN (
    SELECT movie_id, info_type_id
    FROM movie_info
    WHERE note LIKE '%internet%'
      AND info IS NOT NULL
      AND (info LIKE 'USA:% 199%' OR info LIKE 'USA:% 200%')
) AS mi ON mi.movie_id = t.id
JOIN (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'release dates'
) AS it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = t.id
JOIN (
    SELECT id
    FROM company_name
    WHERE country_code = '[us]'
) AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.movie_id = t.id
JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
JOIN complete_cast AS cc ON cc.movie_id = t.id
JOIN (
    SELECT id
    FROM comp_cast_type
    WHERE kind = 'complete+verified'
) AS cct1 ON cct1.id = cc.status_id
